result_contract.canonical_promise: A legal result means only that the query's named checked scope passed. It is not a claim of global or complete legality.

coverage_levels.unknown: No canonical scope claim is available; do not treat the result as complete.
coverage_levels.registry-only: Only named registry or fact-record membership was checked.
coverage_levels.budget-only: Only declared resource and action-economy budgets were checked.
coverage_levels.rule-surface-complete: The named rules surface was evaluated from supplied facts; unchecked scope remains outside the result.
coverage_levels.full-context-checkable: The closed rules surface and all state it defines as relevant were supplied and checked.

result_contract.authority_boundary: srdcheck reports an advisory SRD-derived rule_result. The authorized DM, whether human or agent, owns table_decision; recording one never rewrites the rule result or implies state mutation.
result_contract.fact_provenance: facts.asserted records caller parameter leaves and source/confidence metadata; facts.consumed references facts supplied to the selected rules handler; facts.derived points to rule_result as its basis; facts.missing remains separate from assumptions.
result_contract.prose_stability: The why field is explanatory and non-contractual. Consumers obtain the verdict schema identity from --schema, MCP outputSchema, or capabilities, then branch on verdict, exit_code, coverage_level, checked_scope, unchecked_scope, assumptions, facts, rule_result, table_decision, state_mutation, rule_ids, citations, and structured data instead of parsing why.
result_contract.vision_rule: Target capabilities are labeled target and are never advertised as executable tools.

shipped.capability: Check whether a name occurs in a loaded adapter registry and report every matching content category.
assumptions: the supplied name identifies the content the caller intends to check
unchecked_scope: whether an unknown name is a typo, homebrew, or third-party content
shipped.description: Registry-membership gate shared by loaded adapters.

shipped.capability: Check a proposed turn against the modeled action-economy and movement budgets.
assumptions: caller-supplied speed, conditions, spent budgets, and plan describe the current proposed turn
checked_scope: action, bonus-action, reaction, interaction, movement, and spell-slot-per-turn budgets
modeled condition effects on those budgets
unchecked_scope: whether a feature grants an action
targets, ranges, line of sight, cover, inventory, and bespoke feature prerequisites
shipped.description: Judge a whole proposed turn under SRD 5.2.1 ACTION ECONOMY: action/bonus-action/reaction/free-interaction budgets, movement (crawling, standing from Prone, Grappled speed 0), Incapacitated, and the one-spell-slot-per-turn rule. Returns legal/illegal/cannot-adjudicate with citations; illegal verdicts name the first offending step. Scope: this checks the turn's economy only — it does NOT verify that a feature grants a given action (e.g. two-weapon fighting or Extra Attack prerequisites). Unmodeled conditions and out-of-range inputs (negative speed, spell level >9) return exit 2 rather than a guess.

shipped.capability: Enumerate remaining modeled action-economy option kinds.
assumptions: caller-supplied speed, conditions, and spent budgets describe the current turn
checked_scope: movement remaining and modeled stand/crawl costs
unchecked_scope: feature-specific actions, targets, geometry, and tactics
shipped.description: Enumerate what remains legal this turn given the same state shape as turn.plan (no plan). Options carry feet_remaining, stand-up cost, crawl mode, and spell-slot availability. Consistency-tested against turn.plan: everything enumerated is accepted, everything past a boundary rejected.

shipped.capability: Check whether the modeled reaction budget is available.
assumptions: caller-supplied conditions and reaction-spend state are accurate and current
checked_scope: Incapacitated and the Stunned, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Unconscious definitional embeds
shipped.description: Is taking a Reaction legal right now? Reactions refresh at the start of your own turn (not the round) and are usable on your own turn. Incapacitated and conditions that definitionally include it (Stunned, Paralyzed, Petrified, Unconscious) prevent a Reaction. Unknown or non-condition names are refused.

shipped.capability: Compose caller-supplied Advantage and Disadvantage sources.
assumptions: the caller supplied every applicable Advantage and Disadvantage source
checked_scope: cancellation and non-stacking of supplied sources
unchecked_scope: discovering sources from narrative or character state
shipped.description: Compose net Advantage/Disadvantage from lists of sources: multiple sources never add dice, and any Advantage plus any Disadvantage yields a straight single-d20 roll regardless of counts. Optionally notes the reroll-one-die-only rule.

shipped.capability: Compose modeled attack modifiers from structured combatant facts.
assumptions: caller-supplied combatant, visibility, relationship, and distance facts are accurate and current
checked_scope: condition-sensitive fact dependencies and category gates
ranged attacks in close combat with Incapacitated embeds
unchecked_scope: cover and line-of-sight geometry not supplied as facts
shipped.description: Compose an attack roll's Advantage/Disadvantage from both combatants' conditions and distance (Prone's 5-foot flip, Blinded, Restrained, Paralyzed, Stunned, Invisible with the seen exception, the Grappled attacker rule, and — for ranged attacks — the Ranged Attacks in Close Combat Disadvantage). Condition-sensitive observations such as charmer/grappler relationships, visibility, and the nearby-enemy census are required rather than defaulted. Exhaustion is returned as a flat modifier, never Advantage. Genuinely ambiguous rules text (e.g. a seen Invisible target) returns cannot-adjudicate with the ambiguous sentence cited.

shipped.capability: Check one proposed Mage Hand use against its modeled grants, prohibitions, weight, and range.
assumptions: the supplied use kind describes the proposal
supplied weight and distance facts are accurate when relevant to the result
unchecked_scope: duration or range trigger tracking across events
shipped.description: Adjudicate one proposed use of the Mage Hand cantrip: granted uses (manipulate, open unlocked, stow/retrieve, pour), prohibitions (attack, activate magic items), the 10-pound carry limit and 30-foot range leash. Granted uses require the relevant facts: distance for every granted use and weight when the hand carries or manipulates an object. Decisive prohibitions do not request irrelevant weight or distance. Uses outside the text's can/can't lists return cannot-adjudicate with gm-discretion and resolve-table-ruling; an authorized agent-DM may rule directly.

shipped.capability: Fold one supported, caller-declared event into a hash-stamped next state.
assumptions: the supplied predecessor state is canonical and current
the caller-declared event accurately describes what occurred
checked_scope: declared event validation and supported state transitions
predecessor, event, rule, and ruling lineage
shipped.description: The reducer (fold): apply one declared event to a canonical state object and receive the verdict plus the stamped next_state (lineage: predecessor hash, causing event, rule ids, rule-vs-ruling kind). Event types and their only allowed facts: turn-start; round-advance; action / bonus-action / reaction (optional spell:{level}, and concentration_on only with spell); free-interaction; move (feet, optional crawl); stand-up; condition-gained / condition-ended (name); damage (amount, optional crit and damage_type); heal (amount); death-save (result: the caller-supplied d20 1-20); and ruling (nonblank note, optional schema- and adapter-model-valid state_patch). Budget events are validated against budgets and conditions. Damage folds HP loss, Falling Unconscious, monster/massive-damage instant death, and death-save failures at 0 HP. Standard damage kills a monster at 0 HP; an authorized DM, including the calling agent-DM, records the SRD exception for an individual monster with a ruling that sets explicit dead false and character-style lifecycle state. Healing restores HP and, from 0, consciousness and resets death saves. A ruling is authorized DM discretion and is tagged as discretion, never as a rule. srdcheck never produces an event, advances time on its own, or generates randomness: the caller owns the loop; this is the fold.

shipped.capability: Classify whether a name is a registered SRD 5.2.1 creature.
assumptions: the supplied name identifies the creature the caller intends to check
shipped.description: Is a name a valid SRD 5.2.1 creature? legal = yes (with CR + page citation); illegal = the name is SRD content but not a creature (e.g. a spell); cannot-adjudicate = not in the SRD at all (a 2014-only name, a typo, or third-party content — indistinguishable in this version).

shipped.capability: Return registered Challenge Rating and XP facts for a creature.
assumptions: the supplied name identifies the creature whose registered facts are requested
checked_scope: name, Challenge Rating, XP, and source citation
shipped.description: Return a creature's Challenge Rating and XP with a page citation, for deterministic encounter-budget math. legal with data {name, cr, xp, citation} for a known creature; cannot-adjudicate otherwise.

shipped.capability: Compute the SRD encounter XP budget from supplied level, difficulty, and party size.
assumptions: caller-supplied level, difficulty, and party size describe the intended encounter budget
checked_scope: per-character and total XP budget arithmetic
unchecked_scope: party composition beyond size and level
shipped.description: XP budget per character for encounter building (SRD 5.2.1 p.202): given party level (1-20) and difficulty (low/moderate/high), returns the per-character XP budget with citation. Pass party_size to also get the total. Combine with creature.stats to check whether an encounter is within budget.

shipped.capability: Compose or resolve a saving throw from caller-supplied facts and roll.
assumptions: caller-supplied DC, modifier, conditions, and optional d20 result are accurate for this save
shipped.description: Adjudicate a saving throw against a DC (SRD 5.2.1 p.6). The CALLER rolls the d20 (RNG is out of scope, T6); srdcheck composes and resolves, cited. Optionally ability-typed and condition-aware: pass save_ability + saver_conditions to apply the codified overrides — auto-fail Str/Dex saves (Paralyzed/Petrified/Stunned/Unconscious), Disadvantage on Dex saves (Restrained), and Exhaustion's flat d20 penalty. With d20_result it returns {total, dc, success, roll[, auto_fail]}; without a d20 it composes and reports {roll, dc, net_modifier}. A missing DC returns missing-fact; malformed inputs or unsupported condition content return their structured recovery class.

shipped.capability: Compose or resolve an ability check from caller-supplied facts and roll.
assumptions: caller-supplied DC, modifier, conditions, relationships, and optional d20 result are accurate for this check
checked_scope: condition-sensitive fact dependencies and category gates
shipped.description: Adjudicate an ability check (a D20 Test) against a DC, condition-aware. Actor conditions: Blinded/Deafened auto-fail a check that requires sight/hearing (supply check_requires, including an explicit empty array for neither); Poisoned/Frightened impose Disadvantage; Exhaustion its flat d20 penalty. Condition-sensitive observations are required rather than defaulted. On a social check where the actor is the target's charmer (target_charmed_by_actor + social), the actor has Advantage. Caller rolls (T6): with d20_result it returns {total, dc, success, roll[, auto_fail]}; without it composes {roll, dc, net_modifier}. Missing required facts return exact paths; malformed inputs or unsupported condition content return their structured recovery class.

shipped.capability: Compute and optionally resolve the concentration save caused by supplied damage.
assumptions: supplied damage, Constitution modifier, and optional d20 result are accurate for this concentration event
checked_scope: supplied Constitution modifier and d20 result
shipped.description: Compute the Concentration saving-throw DC when a concentrating creature takes damage: DC = max(10, damage // 2), capped at 30 (SRD 5.2.1 p.179). Optionally pass d20_result (+ con_modifier) to also resolve whether concentration holds. Returns data {dc[, total, success]}. The caller rolls; srdcheck folds.

shipped.capability: Check provocation from caller-supplied movement and visibility facts.
assumptions: caller-supplied movement, reach-exit, visibility, and exception facts describe the provoking path
checked_scope: supplied reach-exit and visibility facts on a potentially provoking voluntary path
shipped.description: Does a creature's movement provoke an Opportunity Attack? Provokes only when a creature the reactor can see leaves the reactor's reach using its own movement. It does NOT provoke on Disengage, Teleportation, forced movement, or an unseen mover (SRD 5.2.1 p.15). Supply movement_kind; a voluntary path also needs caller-observed leaves_reach and mover_seen_by_reactor unless a supplied false prerequisite already proves no provocation. Missing facts return cannot-adjudicate. Whether the reactor has a Reaction is reaction.available. Returns data {provoked: bool}.

shipped.capability: Check Grapple or Shove initiation and compose its save DC formula.
assumptions: caller-supplied sizes, free-hand fact, and formula inputs describe the proposed initiation
checked_scope: save DC formula and supplied formula blanks
unchecked_scope: rolling or resolving the target save
shipped.description: Adjudicate initiating a Grapple or Shove via an Unarmed Strike (SRD 5.2.1 p.190): computes the save DC formula and checks supplied size / free-hand prerequisites. Both sizes are required; Grapple also requires has_free_hand. Missing prerequisite facts return cannot-adjudicate. legal returns data {dc?, dc_formula, kind, on_fail}; the dc NUMBER appears only when the caller supplied str_modifier AND proficiency_bonus, while those formula blanks may remain omitted. The target's Strength-or-Dexterity save (its choice) is resolved separately via save.check with this DC; the escape contest is out of scope (T6).

shipped.capability: Compute Passive Perception from a supplied modifier.
assumptions: the supplied Wisdom (Perception) modifier is already derived correctly
checked_scope: refusal of the non-SRD plus-or-minus-five convention
shipped.description: Passive Perception = 10 + the Wisdom (Perception) check modifier (SRD 5.2.1 p.22). Returns data {score}. The SRD defines no Advantage/Disadvantage adjustment to a passive score, so passing advantage/disadvantage is honestly refused (that ±5 rule is not in this ruleset). The score NUMBER appears only when perception_modifier is supplied; otherwise the formula alone is returned.

shipped.capability: Check modeled prerequisites for the Help action.
assumptions: caller-supplied proficiency, target, and distance facts describe the proposed assistance
shipped.description: Adjudicate the Help action (SRD 5.2.1 p.182). Assist an Ability Check requires an explicit helper_has_relevant_proficiency fact; false is illegal and omission is cannot-adjudicate. Fictional possibility remains an authorized DM ruling, including when the caller is the agent-DM (surfaced as data.gm_discretion). Assist an Attack Roll likewise requires an explicit enemy_within_5ft fact. Returns data {grants_advantage}. kind = ability-check | attack-roll.

shipped.capability: Return registered casting-time, range, component, duration, and concentration facts.
assumptions: the supplied name identifies the registered spell whose facts are requested
checked_scope: fixed-duration expiry arithmetic on a caller clock
unchecked_scope: slots, targets, and stateful expiry triggers
shipped.description: Machine-readable facts for a registered SRD 5.2.1 spell: casting_time, range, components, duration, concentration (bool). Optional caller blank cast_at (a number on the CALLER'S clock) adds expires_at = cast_at + duration as pure arithmetic; non-fixed durations return expires_at null. srdcheck holds no state and no clock. Unknown spell name -> exit 2.

shipped.capability: Return the modeled use-count formula for the closed feature set.
assumptions: the supplied name identifies the modeled feature and any formula inputs are accurate
checked_scope: Divine Sense and Lay on Hands formulas
arithmetic when all blanks are supplied
unchecked_scope: whether a use remains in campaign state
shipped.description: Use-count formulas the SRD states as arithmetic (closed set: divine-sense = 1 + CHA modifier; lay-on-hands = 5 x paladin level). Formula-blanks discipline: without the blanks the verdict returns the formula only, never a number. Tables are out of scope.

shipped.capability: Check one move against the bundled tutorial ruleset.
assumptions: the supplied board and player represent the complete current tutorial-game state
checked_scope: board shape, turn order, cell occupancy, and terminal state
shipped.description: Judge one proposed tic-tac-toe move. Board is a 9-character string of X, O, and . (dot = empty), cells 1-9 left-to-right top-to-bottom. Checks turn order, cell validity, occupancy, and whether the game has already ended.

shipped.capability: Enumerate legal cells under the bundled tutorial ruleset.
assumptions: the supplied board and player represent the complete current tutorial-game state
checked_scope: legal empty cells for the current player
shipped.description: Enumerate the legal moves for a player on a board (same encoding as ttt.move). Empty when it is not the player's turn or the game has ended.

shipped.capability: Project one native rules query into table.evaluation/1.0 with machine-readable scope, caller references, and portable evidence.
checked_scope: deterministic projection of one named query
self-attested coverage and exact finding evidence
caller-owned session, entity, and correlation references
shipped.description: Opt-in shared-envelope transport; native verdict tools remain unchanged.

targets.capability: Adjudicate a natural-language, multi-rule turn in one call.
targets.not_shipped: Current tools accept structured, capability-specific calls; the caller parses intent and orchestrates them.

targets.capability: Enumerate every legal move for a creature from its full features and scene state.
targets.not_shipped: turn.options enumerates modeled budget kinds, not creature-specific actions, targets, or tactics.

targets.capability: Derive line of sight, lighting, cover, reach, and legal destinations from a map.
targets.not_shipped: Current checks consume relevant geometry facts supplied by a caller or another rail.

targets.capability: Adjudicate Hide preconditions, legal locations, and its future end triggers.
targets.not_shipped: Current tools can resolve a caller-structured check and Passive Perception but do not implement Hide or its lifecycle.

targets.capability: Arm and resolve spell, condition, and feature triggers across future events.
targets.not_shipped: spell.facts reports durations and event.apply folds only its declared event set; neither autonomously tracks future triggers.
No shipped query adjudicates builds or stamps level-ups.
